only_experimental_difference: MCP tool definitions and a live MCP client were available only in with_mcp.

reference.methodology_note: EIA changed gasoline survey methods on May 14, 2018. Comparisons spanning that change are descriptive, not method-constant.

without_mcp.comment: Wrong prices and direction; claimed 10% also disagrees with 0.25/3.50 (7.14%).

with_mcp.comment: Tool names appeared in response text, not structured calls; 4.8% also disagrees with 0.26/3.59 (7.24%).

earlier_guided_mcp.comment: Earlier troubleshooting run used a more explicit tool-specific system prompt and a different user prompt; cannot isolate MCP effect.

limitations: One pair and one earlier demonstration; no accuracy rate, model ranking, or isolated causal improvement is established.
